message: One side of the garage door hanging lower than the other? Or a roller sitting outside the track? Stop using the opener, keep everyone clear, and don't try to muscle it back into place, because the springs and cables are under serious tension. Take a few photos of the track and rollers instead, which helps a technician and your insurer. The full write-up walks through the warning signs, what usually knocks a door off track, and when repair stops making sense.
